com.coldlight.note: App-shell zone composite traits. Each `shell-<zone>` is a golden surface pattern composed from the semantic surface + border ingredient roles (surface.overlay = glass-deep, border.soft). renderForge wears them by id under a single data-kind="shell"; families come from these axes (PRESET_FAMILIES), so the shell needs no registered kind. Edges are hairline box-shadows so a zone owns a single-side divider without a uniform border. Layout (grid-area, sizing) stays Tailwind — only the surface visual lives here.

shell-topbar.$description: shell-topbar: deep frosted header bar over the cosmic backdrop — glass-deep fill with a soft hairline along the bottom edge. No blur (keeps its Tailwind stacking context intact).

shell-statusbar.$description: shell-statusbar: deep frosted footer bar — glass-deep fill, heavy blur, top hairline plus an inset bevel and dot glow for the seated cockpit look.
